# Inventory Locations & Fulfilment

# Products: Managing Inventory Across Multiple Locations

Handling inventory across multiple locations requires a clear strategy for how stock levels are synchronized with your online store. In **OrderHub**, these configurations are managed under **Settings > Inventory**.

## Inventory Configuration Modes

There are three primary modes available to determine how stock levels are calculated and displayed to your customers.

### 1. Single Location
This is the default setting for businesses operating out of a single warehouse or storefront.
*   **Function:** OrderHub pushes the exact inventory levels held at your sole location directly to the online store.
*   **Best For:** Small businesses or centralized operations with no secondary storage sites.

### 2. Sum Across All Locations (Aggregate)
This mode treats your entire network of locations as a single pool of inventory.
*   **Function:** OrderHub calculates the **total sum** of stock across every registered location and pushes that combined figure to Pixfizz Online.

### 3. Single Source Mirror
This mode ignores secondary locations for the purpose of online sales, focusing on a specific hub.
*   **Function:** The online store mirrors the stock levels of your designated **Primary Fulfilment Location** only.
*   **Best For:** Businesses with multiple warehouses that designate only one specific site to handle e-commerce fulfillment.

![How OrderHub reports stock for inventory-tracked products to Pixfizz Online](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/f98fb020-e97b-4315-a916-b646e42e8245.png)

---

## Comparison of Inventory Modes

| Mode | Inventory Source | Online Stock Calculation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Single Location** | One Location | Direct 1:1 match of local stock. |
| **Sum Across All Locations** | All Locations | **Location A + Location B + Location C** |
| **Single Source Mirror** | Primary Location Only | **Location A** (Secondary sites ignored) |

---

## Key Configuration Requirements

To ensure accurate stock reporting, keep the following points in mind:

*   **Primary Fulfilment Location:** If you are not aggregating stock (using Single Source Mirror), you **must** assign a Primary Fulfilment location. This acts as the "Source of Truth" for your online storefront.
*   **Stock Updates:** Online availability is updated automatically based on the mode selected; ensure your physical counts are updated in OrderHub to prevent overselling.
*   **Location Settings:** Access these controls via **Settings > Inventory** to toggle between modes as your business scales.
